task:
Outcome A - No-overlap numbers are allowed but flagged.

Today the scenario editor (src/app/(user)/scenario/[id]/edit/EditScenarioClient.tsx) disables Save whenever any Issue's zone check in src/components/scenarios/IssueNumbersEditor.tsx (issueZone) is not ok. That includes limits that simply do not overlap ("No overlap: no deal is possible with these limits"). The API already accepts non-overlapping limits: the scenario codec only rejects targets on the wrong side of their walk-aways.

Change the editor so that non-overlapping walk-aways are a warning, not a blocker: the Issue still shows a warning that says no deal is possible, Save stays enabled, saving succeeds, and after a reload the saved numbers and the warning are still shown. Targets on the wrong side of the walk-aways must keep blocking Save exactly as today (e2e/playwright/acceptance/slice-13.spec.ts relies on it).

The locked Demonstration is e2e/playwright/acceptance/peeraxis-a-no-overlap.spec.ts; its two test.step titles are the owner-approved steps. Peeraxis runs it locally through scripts/peeraxis/demo.sh (it fails today at step 1 because Save is disabled). Add or update unit tests for the new rule (the zone logic and the editor's Save state). The acceptance command is the full check, scripts/peeraxis/check.sh. Change only the allowed paths; no new dependencies.

steps: In your scenario's editor, set an Issue's limits so they don't overlap. A warning says no deal is possible, and Save stays enabled.
Save and reload. The numbers and the warning are still there.
